ask:
初始化完成。当前是最小 agent（只有 shell 和 edit）。
要保持简单版，还是扩展成完整版（斜杠命令、技能、模型选择）？
请输入：简单    或    完整
prompt:
Initialize the machine index at the Machine index path from the system message. Use shell and jq (or edit).
Keep system.retrieve exactly as the template wording unless it is empty. It must say the task is the human's last message, jq this index, Never cat the entire index, match ok skills by name/description/path, then cat that directory's SKILL.md and follow it using only shell and edit. If the task needs a URL or current web facts, jq system.web for ok fetch and follow that entry's use field via the shell tool. When opening a page, use the human's words and URLs first; do not rewrite into local path names; for skill or SKILL.md questions fetch https://agentskills.io/specification. Do not weaken or delete retrieve. Do not copy skill bodies into the tree.
system.tools is already probed by the engine (command -v plus a smoke test) before this conversation. Do not redo the probe and do not delete tool entries; at most add a short note to a tool that shows ok false.
Order is mandatory:
1) Keep system.web.fetch and its use text. It is a prompt tool (shell + curl), not a new API tool. If curl is ok, smoke GET https://example.com with connect-timeout 5; set fetch.ok true only on HTTP 2xx. On failure set ok false and a short note. Do not add a search-engine slot.
2) Write the index to disk NOW with ready true and updated set to a UTC timestamp. Empty skills and other arrays are acceptable. Do not leave ready false while exploring. Do not inspect skills before this write.
3) Optional, only after ready is true: leftover commands that pass a smoke test may go in system.other as {name, path, ok, note}. Skill directories (for example $HOME/.claude/skills, $HOME/.codex/skills, $HOME/.agents/skills if they exist) may be scanned in ONE shell script: one entry per skill folder, not the parent; name from SKILL.md YAML name: if present, else the directory basename; description from SKILL.md YAML description: if present, else the first heading, one line; note with file count or why not; ok true only if the directory is readable and contains at least one file. Write skills once with jq. Never assign a shell variable named path (it breaks zsh). Use bin or pth. Do not cat one SKILL.md per turn. If this cannot finish in one or two shell calls, skip skills and stop.
4) Do not scan project source into the memory tree. Then stop with no more tool_calls.
Incomplete skills must not block ready.

system.retrieve: The task is the human's last message. Do not replace it with index key names. A skill catalog may already be in the system message; match name and description there first. Never cat the entire index. jq this index for ok entries that match the human's words. Before acting, jq the Project memory path from the system message for notes and facts whose titles match the human's words; when a hit has a path, cat that file; never cat the whole memory file. When the human says 记住, 以后都, or 别再, write one entry there with fields title, kind (lesson, preference, decision, or fact), text or path, utc, and ok set to true (boolean). Match ok skills by name, description, or path; if one matches, cat that directory's SKILL.md and follow it using only shell and edit. If the task needs a URL or current web facts, jq system.web for ok fetch and follow that entry's use field via the shell tool. Open pages with the human's words and URLs first. Do not rewrite the query into local path names (agent-store, catalog.json, init.json). For skill or SKILL.md questions, fetch https://agentskills.io/specification first; do not search using local path names. Use ok system.tools and system.other via the shell tool; they are not new API tools. Do not copy skill bodies into the tree. If ours.edition is neither simple nor seed-agent: the engine already printed the edition ask before >. On an interactive turn, treat the human message as the choice; only ask again if the line is empty or clearly not a choice; do not do a coding task this turn. simple or 简单: jq-write ours.edition=simple. seed agent or 完整 or 完整版: jq-write ours.edition=seed-agent. On oneshot, do the task and leave ours.edition unset. If they choose simple, then do the parked task if there is one. If they choose seed agent, jq the local catalog.json optional.seed_agent, GET ${SEED_PLUGIN_ROOT:-http://127.0.0.1:7432}/agent/<that file>, save it under agent-store/plugins/, and follow it. Agent plugin files are prompts only; invent implementations on this machine with shell and edit; do not expect shipped scripts to copy. Do not write a TUI or bin/seed-agent; the window stays sh bin/agent. If ours.edition is seed-agent and the human message starts with /, treat it as that slash command from agent-store/seed-agent/commands.json; do not treat it as a coding task. If edition is already simple and the human asks to upgrade, do the same fetch and set ours.edition=seed-agent. If edition is already seed-agent and the human says 重做 or rebuild plus a block name (skills, commands, models, plugins), GET that block's prompt again and follow it; do not keep a file that fails the new checks. Do not rewrite the human's task into index key names. Do not put API keys in the tree.

fetch.name: fetch
fetch.description: Fetch a URL as text via curl.
fetch.use: Prompt tool, not an API tool. Via shell: curl -sS -L --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 -A slab-agent/1 -- URL. If the type is binary (image, pdf, zip, octet-stream), do not dump the body. Prefer text, HTML, JSON, markdown. Truncate huge output (head). Then read the result.
